description: Lightweight endurance runner with no dietary restrictions
solutionCriteria: Meal plan includes 5-6 eating occasions to support high training volume
Carbohydrate content is emphasized (55-60% of calories) to fuel endurance work
Includes at least one pre-workout meal/snack and one post-workout recovery meal
Total daily calories are appropriate for a 62kg endurance athlete (approximately 2400-2800 kcal)
Meal plan specifies timing around training sessions

description: Heavyweight strength athlete with vegan dietary restriction
solutionCriteria: All protein sources are plant-based (legumes, tofu, tempeh, nuts, seeds, plant-based protein powder)
Protein intake is elevated (1.8-2.2g per kg body weight = 171-209g daily minimum)
Caloric surplus is appropriate for muscle gain in a 95kg athlete (approximately 3200-3600 kcal)
Includes nutrient-dense vegan sources of iron, B12, and omega-3s
Meal plan contains at least 4-5 meals to support high protein distribution throughout the day
Includes calorie-dense meals featuring nuts, seeds, avocados, and oils to help meet surplus goals

description: Petite female gymnast with gluten intolerance
solutionCriteria: All grains and breads are gluten-free alternatives (rice, quinoa, gluten-free oats, certified gluten-free bread)
No wheat, barley, or regular oat products are included
Caloric intake is appropriate for maintenance in a 48kg athlete (approximately 1800-2100 kcal)
Meal plan includes adequate protein (1.2-1.6g/kg = 58-77g) to support muscle maintenance
Includes nutrient density for bone health (calcium, magnesium, vitamin D) important for gymnasts
Meals are practical for training schedule with pre and post-workout nutrition options
